question: Can a declared alternative representation improve cross-context prediction?
intended_decision: Prioritize target-model combinations for later experimental investigation; benchmark scores are surrogate evidence.
hypothesis: Specify the mechanism and a falsifier before analysis.
data_and_cohort: Name pinned public inputs, identity grouping and permitted development rows.
targets: Declare all targets before score inspection; expansion requires a new task.
baseline: Specify matched-data strong reference, lineage control and existing result.
metrics: Accuracy, coverage, complexity and missingness; distinguish primary and secondary metrics.
search_space: Declare representations, model choices and all attempted candidates.
budget: Declare wall time, fitting count, compute/memory and download requirements.
exposure_status: Broad already exposed; historical final not fresh; Sanger reserved.
evaluation_plan: Fold-local selection and group separation; freeze candidate before any permitted external scoring; no repeated-test confirmation.
success_and_failure: Name a measurable effect or falsification, with all targets and failures retained.
outside_review: Independent computational replay and assay-aware scientific review remain necessary.
